li_caption:
For payments made in 2026, the Form 1099-NEC threshold is $2,000, up from $600. Forms go to contractors and the IRS by February 1, 2027.

Fewer forms will be required. The work that decides who gets one has not changed:

1. A W-9 on file for every contractor, ideally before the first payment
2. Payments tracked by vendor and by 1099 box
3. Card and payment-app payments left out, because the processor reports those on Form 1099-K
4. Corporations identified, since most are exempt

Most January scrambles start at step one: the W-9 was never requested and the vendor has stopped replying.
